problem: A newly prepared conversation can retain its own empty configuration pause after an explicit model choice was strictly confirmed. The first-message handoff queues then returns the input without sending.

regression.beforeFix: same not-sent error; 0 prompts; identity still draft
regression.afterFix: real set -> strict confirmation -> pending handoff -> exactly1 accepted prompt

change: After all strict guards succeed, a fresh, unresumed, history-free first-message draft may release only its own empty configuration pause using the existing guarded helper. Established/history/queued/external/unknown pauses retain their prior behavior.

formalRecheck.path: Explicit retry restored the saved Super VL free/off/auto choice, then first Send accepted exactly one prompt; actual tool/result and final reply succeeded.
formalRecheck.scope: Recovered saved-configuration fresh first-send path passed; manual selection still has a separate state-not-ready refusal under investigation.

scopeBoundary: Prior intermittent confirmation failure and mode-list AX behavior remain unexplained; this fix does not claim to resolve them.
